    {

      "keep": false,

      "uncertain": false,

      "continues_later": false,

      "note": null

    {
      "type": "running_header",
      "box_1000": [763, 49, 912, 62],
      "keep": false,
      "reading_order": null,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [{"text": "MAHĀBHĀRATA", "end": "space"}],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [100, 84, 438, 130],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 1,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "तदुदीर्णं महत् सैन्यं त्रैलोक्यस्यापि संजय।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "भयमुत्पादयेत्तीव्रं पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥११॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [100, 134, 429, 179],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 2,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "को हि दुर्योधने सैन्ये पुमानासीन्महारथः।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "यं प्राप्य समरे वीरा न त्रस्यन्ति महाभये॥१२॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [85, 183, 490, 291],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 3,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Verily, O Sanjaya, the innumerable and", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "excellent army of the high-souled sons of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "Pandu, can strike the worlds with keenest", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "apprehension. In this terrific battle, was any", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "great car-warrior in the troop of Duryodhana", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "who was fearless?", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "speaker",
      "box_1000": [244, 300, 331, 317],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 4,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [{"text": "संजय उवाच", "end": "space"}],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [100, 325, 395, 370],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 5,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "देवव्रते तु निहते कुरूणामृषभे तदा।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "किमकार्षुर्नृपतयस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥१३॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "speaker",
      "box_1000": [85, 378, 198, 394],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 6,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [{"text": "Sanjaya said", "end": "space"}],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [85, 398, 490, 448],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 7,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Therefore, O Sanjaya, recount to me what", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "the kings did, when Devarata, the foremost of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "the Kurus, had been slain.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [100, 454, 410, 499],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 8,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "शृणु राजन्नेकमना वचनं ब्रुवतो मम।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "यत्ते पुत्रास्तदाकार्षुर्हते देवव्रते मृधे॥१४॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [85, 503, 489, 555],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 9,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Hear, O monarch, with singleness of mind,", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "the words, falling from my lips, regarding what", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "your sons did when Devavrata had fallen.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [99, 560, 462, 607],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 10,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "निहते तु तदा भीष्मे राजन् सत्यपराक्रमे।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "तावकाः पाण्डवेयाश्च प्राध्यायन्त पृथक् पृथक्॥१५॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [85, 609, 489, 677],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 11,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "O monarch, when Bhishma of invincible", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "prowess had been slain, your own warriors and", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "also those of the Pandava host, began to think", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "of the duties of the Kshatriya sect; and,", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [99, 681, 418, 726],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 12,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "विस्मिताश्च प्रहृष्टाश्च क्षत्रधर्मं निशम्य ते।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "स्वधर्मं निन्दमानास्ते प्रणिपत्य महात्मने॥१६॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [99, 731, 405, 776],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 13,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "शयनं कल्पयामासुर्भीष्मायामितकर्मणे।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "सोपधानं नरव्याघ्र शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥१७॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [84, 778, 490, 901],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 14,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "O lord of men, at the thought, they", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "wondered and were delighted; and in", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "obedience to their sectarian duties, they bowed", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "down to the illustrious Bhishma. Then those", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "foremost of men prepared for Bhishma of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "infinite energy a bed furnished with a pillow,", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "made of close-knotted arrows.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [99, 905, 459, 952],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 15,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "विधाय रक्षां भीष्माय समाभाष्य परस्परम्।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "अनुमान्य च गाङ्गेयं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥१८॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 84, 880, 130],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 16,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "क्रोधसंरक्तनयनाः समवेत्य परस्परम्।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "पुनर्युद्धाय निर्जग्मुः क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः॥१९॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [510, 132, 915, 254],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 17,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Having arranged for Bhishma’s safety and", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "having greeted one another, and with the", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "permission of the son of Ganga and having", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "circumambulated him and looking at each", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "other with eyes coppery with anger, those", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "Kshatriyas, goaded by Destiny, again issued", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "forth for fighting with one another.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 259, 850, 305],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 18,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "ततस्तूर्यनिनादैश्च भेरीणां निनदेन च।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "तावकानामनीकानि परेषां च विनिर्ययुः॥२०॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [510, 308, 914, 362],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 19,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Then to the voice of the trumpets and to the", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "roar of the drums, the army of your sons and", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "that of their adversaries, formed in battle-array.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 367, 823, 412],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 20,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "व्यावृत्तेऽह्नि राजेन्द्र पतिते जाह्नवीसुते।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "अमर्षवशमापन्नाः कालोपहतचेतसः॥२१॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 417, 858, 462],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 21,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "अनादृत्य वचः पथ्यं गाङ्गेयस्य महात्मनः।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "निर्ययुर्भरतश्रेष्ठाः शस्त्राण्यादाय सत्वराः॥२२॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [510, 465, 916, 628],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 22,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "When, O greatest of kings, the son of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "Janhavi (Bhishma) had fallen and when the", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "greater part of the day had worn out, these", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "foremost of the Bharata race, overpowered by", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "the influence of their wrath, and having their", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "reasons bewildered through fate and neglecting", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "the salutary counsel of the illustrious son of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "Ganga, came out in haste grasping their", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "weapons.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 633, 879, 680],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 23,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "मोहात्तव सपुत्रस्य वधाच्छान्तनवस्य च।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "कौरव्या मृत्युसाद्भूताः सहिताः सर्वराजभिः॥२३॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [510, 682, 916, 772],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 24,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Owing to your own foolishness and that of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "your sons and owing to the death of the son of", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "Shantanu, the descendants of the Kuru race", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "together with all the (assembled) kings,", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "appeared to be summoned by the God of death.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 777, 820, 823],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 25,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "अजावय इवागोपा वने श्वापदसंकुले।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "भृशमुद्विग्नमनसो हीना देवव्रतेन ते॥२४॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "translation",
      "box_1000": [510, 825, 915, 897],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 26,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "Like a herd of goats without a herdsman in", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "wood infested with beasts of prey, they were", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "exceedingly oppressed with fear, being", "end": "space"},
        {"text": "deprived of Devavrata.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "type": "verse",
      "box_1000": [524, 902, 838, 949],
      "keep": true,
      "reading_order": 27,
      "uncertain": false,
      "continues_from_earlier": false,
      "continues_later": false,
      "lines": [
        {"text": "पतिते भरतश्रेष्ठे बभूव कुरुवाहिनी।", "end": "line"},
        {"text": "द्यौरिवापेतनक्षत्रा हीनं खमिव वायुना॥२५॥", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "note": null
    }
  ],
